value.answer: Tomorrow in Toronto: showers until around noon, then mainly cloudy with a 60% chance of showers and a risk of thunderstorms through the morning and afternoon. Rain could total 10 to 20 mm. High of 24°C, humidex 28, with southwest wind around 20 km/h gusting to 40 near noon. That's from Environment Canada's forecast issued this morning.
